title: Looker Content Usage and Adoption
dataSources: Looker System Activity (`history`, `pdt_builds`, `scheduled_plan`, `event`, `api_usage`), Looker API queue/PDT metrics, GCP audit logs for Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed reports.
app: Looker System Activity and Admin API via HEC scripted inputs; Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed usage via the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity view=history
| stats count as runs, dc(user_id) as unique_users, latest(_time) as last_used by dashboard_title
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_used)/86400,0)
| sort - runs
description: Ranks Looker dashboards by usage and flags stale content nobody runs, supporting rationalisation of the Looker instance.
value: Unused dashboards add maintenance burden and PDT build load; adoption data guides what to retire and what to invest in.
implementation: Query the `history` view; schedule weekly; share low-usage lists with owners.
visualization: Bar chart of top dashboards, table of stale content.
grandmaExplanation: We show which Looker reports people really use so you can retire the ones nobody looks at.
